source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: In your [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), Typhus may select one enemy unit he can see within 18″. His range drops to 12″ if he is outside an Attached unit. Roll one D6. A 1 deals D3 [mortal wounds](vsdata:core-rule/mortal-wounds) to Typhus’s unit, a 2–5 deals D3 to the enemy and a 6 deals D3+3 to the enemy.
